At the same time Edmonton is a capital of state, it is a big city with high level of life and vast opportunities for active people. | The majority of tourists arrive here by car because of the unique low fuel prices in this part of America. | There are numerous comfortable and convenience motels and campings at tourists' disposal.

The Herald daily. | ... One more petition to the authorities to lift the secrecy grading from the information about UFO sounded in 1994 in the form of so-called Roseville declaration. The reason of the declaration became the non-disclosure by the Government the fact of UFO crack-up near the city Roseville, state New Mexico in 1947. The petition contained request to declassify the materials about UFO research as well as request to stop pressure on the witnesses of crack-up and shift off from their the non-disclosure oath. 'Do you think that your face is uninteresting? Surgeon from plastic surgery center just in several weeks will make you look like your favourite actor, singer or actress.' Such kind of advertisement recently has filled all TV channels and periodicals of America. But now thanks to the Faces and Masks Ltd Company you don't need suffer the painful operations in order to look like your idol. New face masks allow you to change your face as simple as to make the head-dress, make-up or tie. | 'Alive mask' fashion firmly enters our life. To go outside with an uncovered face becomes the top of immodesty. Many people don't take off masks even at home. And why not? They are comfortable, beautiful and moreover they protect you from smog, disease causing microbe and radiation. | In particular all-round usage of 'Alive masks' helped people in America as opposed to Europe absolutely not suffer from Cataclysm.

Robot tale. | So came the turn of the younger son to watch over the field. He clayed himself as Bob the technician taught him and kept on waiting. Right at midnight clatter, crack, groaning sounded and three huge creatures appeared in the field. Their eyes were red, claws were chippy, they have wheels with deep tread and all covered with steel alloy. The monsters begin to take to pieces water sprinkling system, root up the rod posts and rumple potatoes. | Jim straightened and thought, 'if they notice me I rush away down the hill. Whatever drive gear the monsters have they won't risk chasing me over the flank'. But the monsters didn't notice Jim and he understood that Bob the technician was right and the monsters' temperature-sensing elements didn't work when a man is clayed. Jim came courageously to the metal creature and luted the air inlets of the first monster by magic cement that Bob the technician had given him. At the same moment monster smokes, sparks and fritzs. Two other monsters turned to Jim caught him and tore into fourty five pieces. | And all this because of although clay protects from temperature-sensing elements but video cameras in night mode see everything. But Jim forgot to ask Bob the technician about video cameras. The tag of the tale is that enemy military characteristics should be learned thoroughly. || Johnny and Mechanic monster. | Brave boy Johnny lived in a forest hamlet. He was a good and kind boy. People in the hamlet loved him. But once upon a time the big trouble came. TThe hamlet was attacked by evil Mechanic monster. Johnny at the time was in the forest. He heard noise and people's cry. When he came to the hamlet he saw a horrible scene - the Mechanic monster burnt houses and killed people. Johnny was a brave boy that is why he took a heavy stone and threw it into Mechanic monster. | In the morning there was not a whisper of the hamlet. Johnny boy was one of the first to die. | That is why be smarter than Johnny-boy and when you see a Mechanic monster skulk in woods. There's no other way for you to stay alive.

The first and only verse from Jacob. | About Black Kraz. | Listen attentively to the pulsation of the World. | One who able to hear will hear; the heard be aware that | the dash of Black Kraz is furious his power is the devil of the World's energy. His sides look like impenetrable darkness, the varnish blinking like sparkling stars which cut the deepness of the gloom. His exhaustion like black coat covers the whole sky and the air behind him twists in typhoons because the Black Kraz power is great. His marker lights like faraway flashing sheet lightning beyond the horizon of creation. The light of his headlights like ruthless star cuts the twilight of the world, lightens the battlefield. The roar of his engine deafens and the Universe quakes from the boom of his wheels. | Millions of roads stretch in each of the worlds and worlds are numerous. Be aware that under the bedding of dust on any road you find the tread trace of Black Kraz. The road appears from not-being under his wheels and there is no road out of his track. And you are proud of having discovered the new path, so be aware that you are only the second on this road. Gaze in front of you and you will see the tread trace of Black Kraz. And you will inbreathe the energy because there is power in his trace. And driving along the way of Black Kraz be aware that you return his energy into the world. Only the driver could handle the Road, be aware of it.
